description: AND-02 physical-device budgets read by tools/tests/android_device_qualification.py --check-budgets. Limits are the worst reference measurement plus headroom: +25% frame p99, +30% load time, about +15% PSS. Thermal status is Android's PowerManager status (0 none, 1 light, 2 moderate). A new device or a deliberate preset change gets its own measured entry.
